title: (Patched - New Vid on Channel) Every Kuldra Skip Explained – Sub 10 Min Raid Guide | RS Dragonwilds
author: SamFPlays
chapters: Surge + phase dash past the abyssal demon
Skip the hardest part of the raid
description:
⚠️ PATCHED: some skips in this guide no longer work. NEW post-patch 1.0.1 run (11 min) here 👉 https://youtu.be/WpvNjqVmpVM

Stuck on a part of the Kuldra raid? This is a voice-guided walkthrough of every skip in my sub 10 min run, explained step by step so you can pull them off yourself. Use the chapters to jump straight to the skip you need.

Watch the full sub 10 min run (no commentary): https://youtu.be/iu2SL4oyZFQ

CHAPTERS
0:00 Intro & setup
1:00 Windstep to air anima
2:00 Soulscourge skip (phase dash + food trick)
3:35 Skip the black dragon
4:04 Skip the necromancer area
5:20 Skip the poison area
6:24 Surge + phase dash past the abyssal demon
7:14 Skip the hardest part of the raid
9:38 Parkour section
10:36 Skip the entire elemental puzzle
13:15 Skip the Kuldra fight
15:36 Kuldra's heart: where to stand

GEAR & SETUP
- Fleet Foot Infusion: MUST BRING. Cuts sprinting stamina cost by 50%.
- Strong Tea: nice to have, restores +20 Rest.
- Mage weapon: 2-handed mage staff for killing the heart at the end.
- Armour: best mage gear you have.

Which skip gave you the most trouble? Tell me in the comments and I'll help you out. If this got you through the raid, a like helps the channel a ton!

#Dragonwilds #RuneScape #Kuldra
